overview: The legislative assembly of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, seated on Raxus Secundus and coordinating secessionist worlds and corporate sponsors.
history: Separatist Parliament governed galactic affairs during the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Separatist Parliament shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Separatist Parliament established as a governing authority in galactic records
